latest_release.name: v0.2.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* ci: bump actions/cache from 4 to 5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3591
* fix(pickers): remove broken highlight call for autocmds by @clason in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3594
* fix(actions): fixes #699 by @alexmozaidze in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3595
* feat(builtin.colorscheme): update option ignore_builtins by @auipga in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3511
* fix(reuse_win): handle reuse_win for current file jump  by @UN-9BOT in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3403
* fix(from_entry): skip validation with unnamed buffer by @v1nns in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3404
* fix(actions): re-set window-local(!) foldexpr by @clason in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3602
* docs(readme): simplify installation instructions by @clason in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3604

## New Contributors
* @alexmozaidze made their first contribution in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3595
* @auipga made their first contribution in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3511
* @UN-9BOT made their first contribution in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3403
* @v1nns made their first contribution in https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/pull/3404

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
